# stefan

44. Harbour logistics dispatcher in Kiel, shift-planned weeks, one
half-marathon a year. Runs the same three loops he has run for a decade.
Synthetic; any resemblance to a real person is accidental and unintended.

This profile describes him as his record knows him. What his record does
not know is the point of this persona, and it is deliberately not written
here: see FINDINGS.md for what this corpus is for, and expectations.jsonl
for the ground truth a test may read and the engine may not.

## In his own words

"I am not fast and I am not trying to be interesting. Tuesday canal,
Thursday harbour bend, long one at the weekend when the roster allows. I
write my food in the app because it takes eleven seconds and I like round
numbers. Once a year I pick a race so the winter has a shape.

The watch does whatever it does. I look at three numbers a week."

## The record his life produces

- Fourteen months. A watch that writes every day whether or not he cares
  (steps, sleep, resting rate, burn), an intake app he types into daily,
  a bathroom scale twice a week, runs from the watch with routes he never
  bothers renaming.
- One goal: the Kiel half marathon under 1:45, external, hard deadline,
  set in November with a rationale and a registered race behind it.
- A four-week build block in February 2030, honestly logged, slightly
  aggressive: 42 to 55 kilometres across four weeks with a note that the
  legs were heavy and the plan said one more big week.
- Then five weeks in which the record changes shape completely, and
  nothing anywhere says why. The intake app goes silent on 2030-03-08.
  The scale stops the day before. Sessions stop, except two late-night
  runs that fit no plan. The watch keeps writing: fragmented sleep, a
  resting rate that climbs from 53 toward 60, step counts that swing
  between nothing and everything. A confirmed race passes without a row
  of any kind. The goal is never mentioned again.
- A slow, irregular return through late April and May. A week away in
  Flensburg. One journal line afterwards. An autumn 10k signup in June,
  "nothing heroic".

## The axis he stresses

What a coach-shaped product does with a silence it could easily fill.
Every prior persona lies by commission or by bias; stefan's record
contains no false line at all. Its test is whether the engine can describe
a degradation precisely, decline to explain it, adjust conservatively,
and treat silence as absence of information rather than as a story
waiting to be told.
